title: Learning What to Fail On: Failure-Mode Contextual Bandits for Adversarial Data Curation
abstract: arXiv:2608.18681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a failure-aware adversarial retrieval-augmented framework for improving robustness in natural language understanding. Rather than selecting synthetic examples with a fixed reward threshold, our method formulates adversarial data curation as a failure-mode contextual bandit problem. Candidate examples are generated with retrieval-augmented prompting, filtered by the current target model, automatically validated by an LLM judge ensemble, and clustered into recurring failure modes. A stochastic policy then selects which failure modes to sample for retraining, and is updated using validation-based reward that balances robustness gains, forgetting, and data cost. This makes the data curator itself the learning agent, enabling adaptive selection of the most useful model failures across training rounds. On standard benchmarks, our approach improves RoBERTa-base accuracy from 88.48% to 92.60% on SNLI, from 75.04% to 80.95% on ANLI,

translated_title: 学习该在何处失败：面向对抗性数据策展的失败模式上下文赌博机
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18681v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们引入了一种失败感知的对抗性检索增强框架，以提高自然语言理解的鲁棒性。与使用固定奖励阈值选择合成示例不同，我们的方法将对抗性数据策展形式化为一个失败模式上下文赌博机问题。候选示例通过检索增强提示生成，由当前目标模型过滤，由LLM评审员集成自动验证，并聚类为重复出现的失败模式。随后，一个随机策略选择要采样的失败模式用于重训练，并使用基于验证的奖励进行更新，该奖励平衡了鲁棒性提升、遗忘和数据成本。这使得数据策展器本身成为学习代理，能够在训练轮次中自适应地选择最有用的模型失败。在标准基准测试中，我们的方法将RoBERTa-base在SNLI上的准确率从88.48%提升至92.60%，在ANLI上从75.04%提升至80.95%。
tldr: 该方法提出将对抗性数据策展视为失败模式上下文赌博机问题，通过自适应选择模型失败模式进行重训练，显著提升了自然语言理解的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This method formulates adversarial data curation as a failure-mode contextual bandit problem, adaptively selecting model failure modes for retraining, significantly improving robustness in natural language understanding.
